subject: Brightline MAP: checklist, slide skeleton & close runway
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Liao <kate@brightline.ai>, Tina Morales <tina@brightline.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP starter + quick workshop — Brightline pilot

Hi Kate / Tina,

Great to meet you yesterday. As promised, I put together a very lean MAP starter doc and a one-slide skeleton to help align the pilot acceptance criteria, milestones, and a realistic close runway. Rather than a long back-and-forth, I think a 30–45 minute co-author session will get us 80% of the way there.

Quick plan: 
- I’ll drop the MAP doc link below (first draft).
- Proposed workshop: Thu 6/17 10:00–10:45 PT — quick alignment + assign owners.
- Goal: agree acceptance criteria, tech validation steps, and an 8-week close runway.

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc - draft), Close_Runway_Slides_v0.1.gslides (slide skeleton)

Could you confirm availability for the Thu slot or propose two alternatives? Also: any internal stake holders we should loop in (SRE / security)?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

---
Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCDefGhIJkLmNopQrsTUVwxYz/view?usp=sharing

From: Kate Liao <kate@brightline.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP starter + quick workshop — Brightline pilot

Thanks Jonas — this looks helpful. Thu 6/17 10:00 PT works for me; Tina is OOO in the morning but can join the second half.

A few quick notes after skimming the doc: 
- Acceptance criteria: we need an explicit performance target (P95 latency < 300ms) for the inference path — can you surface where you expect that to live in the doc?
- Data access: we’ll need a brief line about dataset access window and scrubbed test data — I’ll attach our internal acceptance checklist.
- Procurement: our procurement team will want a short milestones-to-SOW item (esp around data handling and termination clauses).

I’ll take a stab at adding our acceptance checklist into the doc this afternoon. Can you flag anywhere in the slide skeleton you want the performance callouts?

Best,
Kate Liao
Head of AI Integrations | Brightline
kate@brightline.ai

Attachment: Brightline_Acceptance_Checklist.pdf (referenced; will upload to the doc)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Liao <kate@brightline.ai>, Tina Morales <tina@brightline.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP starter + quick workshop — Brightline pilot

Kate — perfect, thanks. High level responses and next ops steps below (adding for the workshop agenda):

1) Where the perf targets live
- I added a "Performance & Gating" section in the MAP doc (Section 2). Quick note there with a placeholder: "P95 inference latency target: 300ms (internal measurement at 1k TPS simulation)". We can tune during the tech validation step.

2) Data access 
- Added a short bullet under "Test Data & Security": dataset window, scrubbed dataset owner, and expected delivery date (TBD). Kate — once you paste your checklist I will convert the relevant lines into acceptance gates.

3) Procurement milestones 
- Under the Close Runway slide I added a timeline lane for procurement sign-off and SOW submission (week 3–4). We deliberately keep week 0–2 for tech validation and week 3 for procurement review.

4) Workshop agenda (6/17, 10:00–10:45 PT) — draft
- 10:00 (5 min) introductions + success definition
- 10:05 (15 min) MAP walkthrough: acceptance criteria + owners
- 10:20 (15 min) Tech validation plan & perf gating (Jonas + Marissa)
- 10:35 (10 min) Procurement & next steps (Kate + Jasmine)

5) Pre-work request (short):
- Kate/Tina: paste acceptance checklist into the MAP doc comments by EOD 6/16 if possible.
- Marissa: prepare a one-paragraph tech validation plan and one test matrix row for the doc.
- Jasmine: confirm commercial milestones to slot into Close Runway.

Attachments referenced: Brightline_MAP_Template_v1.gdoc, Close_Runway_Slides_v0.1.gslides

If that agenda looks good I’ll lock the calendar and send an invite with the doc links.

Cheers,
Jonas
